data.name: Silent Howl
data.detailed_description:
In Silent Howl, the picturesque charm of a small forest village hides a bloody truth. Every night is a fight for survival. Paranoia sets in as a group of Villagers desperately tries to unmask the Werewolves hiding among them.

Manipulate, deduce, bluff, and betray to ensure your faction's triumph. Will you see through the deception to save the village... or devour it from within?

🌑 THREE FACTIONS, THREE WAYS TO SURVIVE

  • Your objective: Unmask and banish all Werewolves before it's too late.

  • The day is your domain. Complete your tasks to help the community and gather clues. Use your role's unique powers (the Witch, the Hunter, the Seer...) to protect the innocent or uncover secrets. During the council, your rhetorical skills and deductive reasoning will be your best weapons to send the guilty to the gallows.

  • Your objective: Devour enough Villagers to take total control.

  • Blend in with the crowd during the day, fake your tasks, and sow discord during debates to frame innocent players. When night falls, reveal your true nature, prowl through the shadows, and coordinate with your pack to eliminate your targets without leaving any witnesses behind.

  • Your objective: Win alone, entirely on your own terms.

  • You are loyal neither to the Village nor to the Wolves. Play as formidable and unpredictable solo roles, like the Assassin who only seeks to be the last one standing, or the Angel whose sole purpose is to be sacrificed by the village on the very first day. Deceive everyone and snatch victory right from under the noses of the two main factions.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • Thrilling Online Multiplayer: Gather your friends or face off against players from around the world. In this social deduction game, your greatest asset isn't your reflexes, but your ability to lie with a straight face or untangle truth from fiction.

  • A Roster of Over 11 Unique Roles: Much more than a standard clash. Each role drastically changes the gameplay mechanics and offers endless replayability.

  • Dynamic Day/Night Cycle: The day is dedicated to exploration, tasks, and crucial votes where every voice matters. At night, silence falls, true identities are revealed, and predators strike.

  • Social and Psychological Strategy: Forge fragile alliances, get inside your opponents' heads, and make logical deductions based on everyone's movements and alibis.

The sun rises. A body has been discovered. Who will you trust when every word could be a lie? Prepare your best arguments, sharpen your fangs, and join the hunt.

Will you survive the night... or will you be the next victim?

But beware, powerful hidden roles can shift the balance. Will you expose the truth and save the village, or tear it apart from within?
